pack.name: AI & Agents
pack.description: Run Claude Code and Codex unattended — headless prompts, repo digests, autofix — plus AI prompt patterns.

templates.name: Claude Code Headless Run
templates.description: Run the Claude Code CLI unattended against a repo on a schedule with a fixed prompt. Non-interactive (`-p`), fenced by `--permission-mode dontAsk`, scoped to the tools you list, output captured to a log.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.help: The instruction Claude runs each time. Avoid single quotes (they close the PowerShell string).

parameters.label: Allowed tools
parameters.help: Comma-separated Claude Code tool allowlist, e.g. Read,Grep,Glob or Bash(git log *),Edit. dontAsk still auto-denies anything not listed. See the Claude Code --allowedTools docs for the exact syntax.

parameters.label: Max turns
parameters.help: Abort the run after this many agentic turns (bounds runtime and cost).

parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Claude model alias to run.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where the run output (Claude's printed result + any errors) is captured.

templates.name: Claude Code Repo Digest
templates.description: A read-only Claude Code run that summarizes a repository into a Markdown digest on a schedule (e.g. weekly). Tools are locked to read/search only; the printed digest is written to a report file.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Digest prompt
parameters.default: Summarize the notable changes, open TODOs, and anything that looks risky in this repository into a concise Markdown digest.
parameters.help: What to summarize. Read-only tools only — avoid single quotes.

parameters.label: Max turns
parameters.help: Abort the run after this many agentic turns.

parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Claude model alias to run.

parameters.label: Report file path
parameters.help: Where the Markdown digest is written.

templates.name: Claude Code Auto-Fix & Commit
templates.description: Higher-trust: let Claude Code edit a repo and commit on a schedule. Still fenced by `--permission-mode dontAsk` — only the edit/git tools you list are pre-approved. Scope `--allowedTools` narrowly and review the log/commits.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.help: The task Claude performs, e.g. "Fix lint errors and commit". Avoid single quotes.

parameters.label: Allowed tools
parameters.help: Edit + scoped git tools pre-approved for the run. Keep Bash scoped (e.g. Bash(git commit *)), never a bare Bash. dontAsk auto-denies anything not listed.

parameters.label: Max turns
parameters.help: Abort the run after this many agentic turns.

parameters.label: Model
parameters.help: Claude model alias to run.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where the run output is captured for review.

templates.name: Claude Code Log Cleanup
templates.description: Housekeeping companion for the scheduled Claude runs: delete run logs/digests older than a cutoff so they do not pile up. Read-nothing, deletes only matching files in one folder.

parameters.label: Log folder
parameters.help: Folder holding the Claude run logs to prune.

parameters.label: File filter
parameters.help: Which files to consider, e.g. claude-*.log or *.md.

parameters.label: Keep for (days)
parameters.help: Delete matching files older than this many days.

templates.name: Codex Headless Run
templates.description: Run Codex CLI non-interactively against a repo on a schedule with a fixed prompt. Uses `codex exec`, no approval prompts, an explicit sandbox, an ephemeral session, and captured output.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.help: The instruction Codex runs each time. Avoid single quotes (they close the PowerShell string).

parameters.label: Sandbox
parameters.help: Least privilege for the run. read-only is safest; workspace-write allows Codex to edit files inside the repo.

parameters.label: Final output path
parameters.help: Where Codex writes the final agent message via --output-last-message.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where the full non-interactive run stream is captured for review.

templates.name: Codex Repo Digest
templates.description: A read-only Codex run that summarizes a repository into a Markdown digest on a schedule. The final digest and full run stream are captured separately.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Digest prompt
parameters.default: Summarize the notable changes, open TODOs, and anything that looks risky in this repository into a concise Markdown digest.
parameters.help: What to summarize. This template runs Codex in a read-only sandbox. Avoid single quotes.

parameters.label: Report file path
parameters.help: Where the Markdown digest is written.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where the full run stream is captured for review.

templates.name: Codex Auto-Fix Workspace
templates.description: Higher-trust: let Codex edit a repository on a schedule. Runs non-interactively with no approval prompts but stays inside the workspace-write sandbox; review the diff and logs before pushing.

parameters.label: Repository path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the local git repository.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.default: Fix straightforward lint, formatting, or test failures in this repository. Keep changes small and summarize every file changed.
parameters.help: The task Codex performs. It may edit files inside the repo. Avoid single quotes.

parameters.label: Summary file path
parameters.help: Where Codex writes the final summary.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where the full run stream is captured for review.

templates.name: Morning News Digest
templates.description: Summarize top stories from your news sources into a daily digest.
templates.commandTemplate: Summarize the top stories from {{feeds}} into a {{length}} digest.

parameters.label: News sources / feeds
parameters.help: Comma-separated RSS feeds or topics to summarize.

parameters.label: Digest length
parameters.help: How long the summary should be.

templates.name: GitHub PR Triage
templates.description: Triage new pull requests in a repo and label them by content.
templates.commandTemplate: Triage new pull requests in {{repo}} and label them by content and priority.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.help: The owner/name of the GitHub repo to triage.
